How VLAs Fail Differently: Black-Box Action Monitoring Reveals Architecture-Specific Failure Signatures VLA

VLA failure signatures action monitoring discrete vs continuous architectures conformal calibration SafeContract

简要说明：本文系统评估了VLA架构（VQ-BeT、Diffusion Policy、ACT）在机器人操作中的失败模式，发现失败特征因架构而异，没有单一监控器能通用，并提出了SafeContract黑箱动作监控工具。

TLDR: This paper systematically evaluates failure patterns of VLA architectures (VQ-BeT, Diffusion Policy, ACT) in robotic manipulation, showing that failure signatures are architecture-specific and no single monitor works universally, and introduces SafeContract for black-box action monitoring.

Abstract: We discover that VLA architectures fail in fundamentally different, predictable ways at the motor-command level. Running VQ-BeT, Diffusion Policy, and ACT on identical evaluation protocols (n=450 episodes across PushT and ALOHA 14-DOF bimanual manipulation), we find: (1) direction reversal rate is a universal failure predictor across all three architectures (AUROC=0.93, 0.79, 0.91; p<0.001); (2) jerk monitoring is predictive only for discrete-token architectures, following a discrete-to-continuous gradient (0.88, 0.69, 0.41); (3) velocity violations alone are non-predictive everywhere (AUROC 0.41-0.69), yet velocity checking is the most common safety mechanism in VLA deployment code; and (4) for continuous-family VLAs, velocity monitoring provides effectively zero predictive signal (AUROC=0.52 on ACT, 0.41 on Diffusion), proving that architecture-matched monitor selection is essential. These results quantify a monitoring consequence of the well-known discrete/continuous VLA distinction: the two families produce qualitatively different failure signatures that require different monitors. No single monitor works universally; architecture-matched selection is required. This finding was enabled by SafeContract, a training-free, black-box action monitoring toolkit with conformal calibration. Code: https://github.com/krishnam94/vla-edge

摘要（中文）：我们发现，VLA 架构在运动指令层面会以根本不同且可预测的方式失效。通过对 VQ-BeT、Diffusion Policy 和 ACT 执行相同的评估方案（在 PushT 和 ALOHA 14 自由度双臂操作任务上共进行 450 个回合的试验），我们得出以下结论：（1）方向反转率是所有三种架构通用的失效预测指标（AUROC 分别为 0.93、0.79、0.91；p<0.001）；（2）加加速度监测仅对离散词元架构具有预测能力，呈现从离散到连续的梯度变化（0.88、0.69、0.41）；（3）仅凭速度违规在所有架构中均不具备预测能力（AUROC 在 0.41–0.69 之间），然而速度检测却是 VLA 部署代码中最常见的安全机制；（4）对于连续型 VLA，速度监测提供的预测信号有效为零（在 ACT 上 AUROC=0.52，在 Diffusion 上为 0.41），这证明匹配架构的监测器选择至关重要。这些结果量化了已知离散/连续 VLA 区分所带来的监测后果：两类架构会产生性质不同的失效特征，需要不同的监测器。没有任何单一监测器能普遍适用，必须进行与架构匹配的选择。这一发现得益于 SafeContract——一种无需训练、基于黑箱操作的行动监测工具包，并配有保形校准功能。代码地址：https://github.com/krishnam94/vla-edge

Authors: Krishnam Gupta

ProgVLA: Progress-Aware Robot Manipulation Skill Learning VLA

vision-language-action model progress-aware training offline reinforcement learning Perceiver resampling robot manipulation

简要说明：ProgVLA提出了一种紧凑的VLA模型，通过两阶段Perceiver重采样方案和基于离线RL的进度感知训练，在严格计算预算下于长周期操作任务中达到具有竞争力甚至更高的成功率。

TLDR: ProgVLA introduces a compact VLA model with a two-stage Perceiver resampling scheme and progress-aware training via offline RL, achieving competitive or superior success rates on long-horizon manipulation tasks under tight compute budgets.

Abstract: We present ProgVLA, a compact vision-language-action (VLA) model designed for reliable robot manipulation under tight compute and memory budgets. The model specifically focuses on efficiently processing long multi-modal sequences by maintaining an explicit representation of task progress over extended horizons. To this end, ProgVLA integrates two key components. First, a multi-modal encoder with a two-stage Perceiver resampling scheme compresses variable-length visual, language, and proprioceptive streams into a fixed set of control-ready context tokens, substantially reducing sequence length while preserving cross-modal grounding. Second, an auxiliary set of progress heads is trained with offline reinforcement learning (RL) objectives to jointly learn critics over normalized remaining-horizon targets. This provides the policy with an internal estimate of task progress and enables advantage- and success-weighted flow-matching imitation learning. On two well-established multi-task robot manipulation benchmarks, a 0.1B-parameter ProgVLA model reaches success rates that are competitive with, and on long-horizon and harder task tiers exceed, substantially larger pretrained baselines. Ablations indicate that the learned context resampler and task-adaptive visual fine-tuning are the largest single contributors, while progress-aware training provides a consistent additional gain that is concentrated on long-horizon and multi-object tasks. We further validate the approach in real-world toy-kitchen environments.

摘要（中文）：我们提出ProgVLA，一种紧凑的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，专为在严格计算和内存预算下实现可靠的机器人操作而设计。该模型的核心在于通过维护任务进度在扩展时间跨度上的显式表示，高效处理长程多模态序列。为此，ProgVLA集成了两个关键组件。首先，采用两阶段感知器重采样方案的多模态编码器，将可变长度的视觉、语言和本体感受流压缩为固定数量的控制就绪上下文令牌，在保持跨模态对齐的同时大幅缩减序列长度。其次，一组辅助进度头通过离线强化学习（RL）目标进行联合训练，以学习针对归一化剩余时间跨度的评判器。这为策略提供了任务进度的内部估计，并实现了基于优势与成功加权的流匹配模仿学习。在两个成熟的多任务机器人操作基准测试中，0.1B参数的ProgVLA模型在成功率上达到了与更大规模的预训练基线相竞争的水平，并在长程及更难的任务层级上超越后者。消融实验表明，学习的上下文重采样器与任务自适应视觉微调是最大的单独贡献因素，而进度感知训练则提供了集中于长程与多目标任务的一致附加增益。我们进一步在现实世界的玩具厨房环境中验证了该方法。

Authors: Seungsu Kim, Jinyoung Choi, Seungmin Baek, Jean-Michel Renders

Tabero: Learning Gentle Manipulation with Closed-Loop Force Feedback from Vision, Touch, and Language VLA

Vision-Language-Action models tactile feedback gentle manipulation closed-loop force feedback hybrid controller

简要说明：Tabero 提出了一个用于轻柔、语言指令的机器人操作的基准和模型套件，利用视觉、触觉和力反馈，在轻柔指令下平均夹持力降低超过 70%。

TLDR: Tabero introduces a benchmark and model suite for gentle, language-conditioned robotic manipulation that leverages vision, touch, and force feedback, achieving over 70% reduction in grip force under gentle instructions.

Abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for robots to achieve human-like gentle manipulation. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models struggle to exploit tactile feedback for gentle manipulation due to scarce aligned vision-tactile-language data and the lack of effective closed-loop force feedback mechanisms. To address these challenges, we introduce Tabero, a benchmark and model suite for gentle, language-conditioned robotic manipulation that demands fine-grained contact force perception. First, the Tabero benchmark addresses the scarcity of tactile data by presenting a data-efficient pipeline that repurposes open-source robot manipulation trajectories to generate diverse vision-tactile-language tasks, and establishes a multidimensional evaluation protocol that measures task success alongside physical interaction quality. Second, we propose Tabero-VTLA, an architecture with a decoupled force-position command interface; the resulting force-position commands are executed by a fixed hybrid controller to enable real-time, force-aware manipulation. Evaluated on Tabero, our model maintains high task success while reducing average grip force by over 70\% under gentle instructions, demonstrating its ability to modulate interaction forces based on multimodal experience. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/NathanWu7/Tabero.

摘要（中文）：触觉感知对于机器人实现类人轻柔操作至关重要。然而，现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型由于缺乏对齐的视觉-触觉-语言数据以及有效的闭环力反馈机制，难以利用触觉反馈实现轻柔操作。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了Tabero——一个面向需要精细接触力感知的轻柔、语言条件化机器人操作的基准测试与模型套件。首先，Tabero基准测试通过一种数据高效流水线解决了触觉数据稀缺问题：该流水线复用开源机器人操作轨迹以生成多样化的视觉-触觉-语言任务，并建立了测量任务成功性与物理交互质量的多维评估协议。其次，我们提出了Tabero-VTLA架构，该架构采用解耦的力-位置命令接口；生成的力-位置命令由固定混合控制器执行，从而实现实时、力感知操作。在Tabero上的评估表明，我们的模型在保持高任务成功性的同时，在轻柔指令下平均夹持力降低超过70%，验证了其基于多模态经验调节交互力的能力。我们的代码已在https://github.com/NathanWu7/Tabero公开。

Authors: Qiwei Wu, Rui Zhang, Xin Xiang, Tao Li, Weihua Zhang, Junjie Lai, Renjing Xu

Uni-LaViRA: Language-Vision-Robot Actions Translation for Unified Embodied Navigation VLN

zero-shot navigation multimodal large language model vision-language-action embodied navigation agentic architecture

简要说明：Uni-LaViRA 是一种零样本智能体架构，通过将导航分解为基于语言的指令和基于像素的视觉目标动作，利用预训练的多模态大语言模型，无需任何机器人训练数据即可统一多种导航任务和真实机器人平台。

TLDR: Uni-LaViRA is a zero-shot agentic architecture that unifies embodied navigation across multiple tasks and real robots by decomposing navigation into language-based direction and vision-based pixel target actions, using a pretrained MLLM without any robot training data.

Abstract: Embodied navigation requires an agent to map language and visual observations to a stream of spatial actions that drive a real robot through environments it has never seen. The dominant approach has been to scale vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models on ever-larger collections of robot trajectories. This paper argues that, for navigation specifically, generality can be obtained structurally, not only through data scale. The underlying decision structure of navigation reduces to a single Language-Vision-Robot Actions Translation. The language action emits semantic-level directional command and the vision action emits a pixel-level visual target. Both outputs lie inside the natural output manifold of pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs), so the task can be reasoned about by an agent rather than learned from robot data. Therefore, we present Uni-LaViRA, a unified agentic architecture that extends the same insight to four task families (VLN-CE, ObjectNav, EQA, and Aerial-VLN) and to four heterogeneous real robots (Wheeled, Quadruped, Humanoid robot, and a self-built UAV) in a zero-shot manner. Two agent-loop mechanisms make this unification practical. TODO List Memory (TDM) rewrites a structured checklist of pending sub-goals at every step, reciting the unfinished items back into the agent's most recent attention window. Second Chance Backtrack (SCB) rolls the robot back to the pre-error state and conditions the agent's next plan on the failed sub-trajectory, turning single-pass navigation into a self-correcting process. With zero training effort, Uni-LaViRA reaches 60.7% SR on VLN-CE R2R, 51.3% on VLN-CE RxR, 77.7% on HM3D-v2, 60.0% on HM3D-OVON, 54.7% on MP3D-EQA, and 40.0% on OpenUAV, matching or even surpassing recent training navigation foundation models that consume millions of samples and thousands of GPU-hours.

摘要（中文）：具身导航要求智能体将语言和视觉观测映射为一系列空间动作，从而驱动真实机器人在从未见过的环境中移动。主流方法是在不断扩大的机器人轨迹数据集上扩展视觉-语言-动作基础模型。本文提出，对于导航这一具体任务而言，通用性不仅可以通过数据规模获得，也可以通过结构方式实现。导航的底层决策结构可简化为单一的“语言-视觉-机器人动作翻译”：语言动作输出语义级方向指令，视觉动作输出像素级视觉目标。这两种输出均位于预训练多模态大语言模型自然输出流形之内，因此该任务可由智能体进行推理，而非从机器人数据中学习。基于此，我们提出Uni-LaViRA——一种统一的智能体架构，将相同思路以零样本方式扩展到四个任务族（VLN-CE、ObjectNav、EQA和Aerial-VLN）及四种异构真实机器人（轮式、四足、人形机器人和自建无人机）。两个智能体循环机制使这种统一成为现实：待办事项列表记忆在每个步骤重写待完成子目标的结构化清单，将未完成项重新注入智能体最近的注意力窗口；二次机会回溯将机器人回滚至错误前状态，并让智能体基于失败子轨迹制定下一步计划，将单次导航转变为自校正过程。无需任何训练，Uni-LaViRA在VLN-CE R2R上达到60.7%的成功率，在VLN-CE RxR上达到51.3%，在HM3D-v2上达到77.7%，在HM3D-OVON上达到60.0%，在MP3D-EQA上达到54.7%，在OpenUAV上达到40.0%，匹配甚至超越了近期消耗数百万样本和数千GPU小时的训练型导航基础模型。

Authors: Hongyu Ding, Sizhuo Zhang, Ziming Xu, Jinwen Guo, Hongxiu Liu, Xingzhi Cheng, Zixuan Chen, Haifei Qi, Duo Wang, Hao Xu, Jieqi Shi, Yifan Zhang, Jing Huo, Jian Cheng, Yang Gao, Jiebo Luo

Beyond Binary: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Manipulation with Physics-Grounded Contact Representation Manipulation

sim-to-real dexterous manipulation tactile representation Center-of-Pressure reinforcement learning

简要说明：提出基于物理原理的接触表示——压力中心（CoP），用于灵巧操作，在多指手上实现了接触密集型任务的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: Introduces Center-of-Pressure (CoP) as a physics-grounded tactile representation for dexterous manipulation, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on contact-rich tasks with a multi-fingered hand.

Abstract: A primary bottleneck in contact-rich manipulation is the difficulty of collecting real-world data. Sim-to-real reinforcement learning offers a scalable alternative, but the simulation-reality gap prevents information-dense modalities like touch from being effectively used. Existing sim-to-real methods often mitigate this gap by simplifying tactile data into coarse low-dimensional features -- sacrificing the richness required for complex manipulation. In this work, we introduce Center-of-Pressure (CoP), an effective tactile representation grounded in physical principles that preserves dense contact information while maintaining robustness for sim-to-real transfer. To support this representation, we propose a sensor calibration scheme based on differentiable dynamics, enabling the estimation of taxel orientations without requiring ground-truth force measurements. We evaluate CoP on two blind, challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks: peg-in-hole insertion and ball balancing. Across both tasks, policies conditioned on CoP achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a multi-fingered hand, and outperform both coarse binary-contact and raw-taxel baselines. Analysis of learned policy states further suggests that CoP-conditioned policies encode task-relevant physical properties, such as object mass, as an emergent byproduct of control.

摘要（中文）：接触密集型操作的主要瓶颈在于真实世界数据采集的困难。仿真到现实的强化学习提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但仿真与现实的差距阻碍了触觉等高信息密度模态的有效利用。现有的仿真到现实方法通常通过将触觉数据简化为粗糙的低维特征来缓解这一差距——这牺牲了复杂操作所需的丰富性。在本工作中，我们引入了一种基于物理原理的有效触觉表征——压力中心（Center-of-Pressure, CoP），它在保持密集接触信息的同时，对仿真到现实的迁移具有鲁棒性。为支持该表征，我们提出了一种基于可微动力学的传感器校准方案，无需真实力测量值即可估计触觉传感器单元的朝向。我们在两项盲态、高难度的接触密集型操作任务（插销入孔和球体平衡）上评估了CoP。在这两项任务中，基于CoP的策略在多指手上实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移，并优于粗糙的二进制接触基线和原始触觉单元基线。对所学策略状态的分析进一步表明，基于CoP的策略将物体质量等任务相关物理属性编码为控制的涌现副产物。

Authors: Jiahe Pan, Stelian Coros, Jitendra Malik, Toru Lin

PrimitiveVLA: Learning Reusable Motion Primitives for Efficient and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action models motion primitives zero-shot generalization robotic manipulation multimodal canonical representation

简要说明：PrimitiveVLA 提出一个框架，通过多模态规范表示将演示分解为可复用的运动基元，从而提升 VLA 模型在机器人操作中的数据效率和零样本泛化能力。

TLDR: PrimitiveVLA proposes a framework that decomposes demonstrations into reusable motion primitives via a multimodal canonical representation, improving data efficiency and zero-shot generalization of VLA models for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for generalist robotic policies, yet their adaptation is hindered by data inefficiency and poor generalization. We argue that these bottlenecks stem from the prevailing Direct Instruction-to-Control Mapping, which forces models to memorize monolithic trajectories rather than reusable motion patterns, i.e., primitives. We propose PrimitiveVLA, a framework that shifts this paradigm toward a Primitive-Centric Disassemble & Assemble paradigm. Supported by a shared Multimodal Canonical Representation (MCR), PrimitiveVLA unifies two phases: (1) Fine-tuning-phase Disassembly, which uses an automated pipeline to disassemble demonstrations into reusable primitives; and (2) Inference-phase Assembly, which employs a VLM-based planner and an LLM-generated switch module for robust closed-loop execution. By disassembling tasks into reusable primitives, PrimitiveVLA enables VLA models to learn invariant motion patterns instead of task-specific trajectories. Extensive experiments show that our framework improves data efficiency and achieves superior zero-shot generalization across unseen and long-horizon tasks.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为通用机器人策略提供了一种有前景的范式，但其适配过程受到数据效率低下和泛化能力不足的制约。我们认为，这些瓶颈源于当前主流的直接指令-控制映射模式——该模式迫使模型记忆整体的轨迹片段而非可复用的运动模式（即基元）。为此，我们提出PrimitiveVLA框架，将这一范式转向以基元为中心的"拆解-组装"模式。借助共享的多模态规范表征（MCR），PrimitiveVLA统一了两个阶段：（1）微调阶段的拆解过程，通过自动化流水线将示范数据分解为可复用基元；（2）推理阶段的组装过程，采用基于VLM的规划器与由大语言模型生成的切换模块实现鲁棒的闭环执行。通过将任务拆解为可复用基元，PrimitiveVLA使VLA模型能够学习不变的运动模式而非特定任务的轨迹。大量实验表明，我们的框架提升了数据效率，并在未见任务及长时域任务上实现了优越的零样本泛化能力。

Authors: Yutai Li, Shaohui Peng, Jiaming Guo, Di Huang, Zihao Zhang, Yuxuan Guo, Yunkai Gao, Siming Lan, Ling Li, Xing Hu, Yunji Chen

SPRINT: Efficient Spectral Priors for Humanoid Athletic Sprints HumanoidEmbodied

frequency-adaptive spectral priors zero-shot sim-to-real transfer humanoid athletic sprints kinematic reference library Unitree G1

简要说明：SPRINT 提出频率自适应频谱先验，为仿人机器人生成运动学可行的关节轨迹，在 Unitree G1 机器人上实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，峰值速度达 6 米/秒。

TLDR: SPRINT introduces frequency-adaptive spectral priors to generate kinematically feasible joint trajectories for humanoid sprinting, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on the Unitree G1 robot at speeds up to 6 m/s.

Abstract: The pursuit of humanoid athletic sprints is hindered by a scarcity of humanoid-viable kinematic reference data and the inability of existing frameworks to maintain stability during sprints. To overcome these limitations, we introduce SPRINT, a novel framework driven by efficient, frequency-adaptive spectral priors. By characterizing the fundamental periodicity of human locomotion in the frequency domain using a reference library of five discrete motion sequences, these priors generate kinematically feasible joint trajectories across a broad velocity spectrum, successfully extrapolating to speeds that exceed the reference distribution. Guided by these pretrained priors, the SPRINT policy achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in field experiments on the Unitree G1 platform, reaching a peak sprinting velocity of 6 m/s and demonstrating seamless gait transitions while preserving biomimetic naturalness. Ultimately, this work establishes frequency-adaptive spectral priors as a highly data-efficient foundation for humanoid athletic sprints. The project page is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/SPRINT-138A/.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 仿人机器人运动冲刺的探索受到两方面因素的制约：一是缺乏适用于仿人机器人的运动学参考数据，二是现有框架无法在冲刺过程中维持稳定性。为克服这些局限，我们提出SPRINT——一种由高效、频率自适应频谱先验驱动的新型框架。通过利用包含五个离散运动序列的参考库，在频域中刻画人类运动的基本周期性，这些先验能够生成覆盖宽速度谱的运动学可行关节轨迹，并成功外推至超出参考分布的速度范围。在这些预训练先验的引导下，SPRINT策略在Unitree G1平台的实地实验中实现了从仿真到实机的零样本迁移，达到6米/秒的峰值冲刺速度，并在保持仿生自然性的同时展现出无缝步态转换。最终，本研究确立了频率自适应频谱先验作为仿人机器人运动冲刺的高数据效率基础。项目页面详见：https://anonymous.4open.science/w/SPRINT-138A/。

Authors: Yantong Wei, Kaihong Huang, Hainan Pan, Jiawei Luo, Jiawei Zhou, Ziyan Mai, Zhiwen Zeng, Yaonan Wang, Huimin Lu

What Frozen VLAs Already Know About Success: A Probing Study of Value-Like Structure in Foundation Robot Policies VLA

VLA linear probing value function success prediction test-time selection

简要说明：本文表明，冻结的VLA策略隐式编码了关于任务成功的价值信息，可通过轻量线性探针提取，并在测试时用于改进动作选择，而无需重新训练策略。

TLDR: This paper shows that frozen VLA policies implicitly encode value-like information about task success, which can be extracted via lightweight linear probes and used to improve test-time action selection, without retraining the policy.

Abstract: Vision--language--action (VLA) policies are trained to imitate actions; their loss never asks them to estimate reward, progress, or future success. Their frozen representations nevertheless carry such information, and it can be read out and used to guide action choice without retraining the policy. From mixed successful and failed manipulation trajectories on LIBERO-Goal, we recover Monte-Carlo outcome targets using lightweight linear probes on frozen features. The targets are consistently predictable from OpenVLA, Pi0.5, DINOv2, and CLIP features, and substantially less so from baselines built on progress, time-to-go, task identity, or proprioception. To rule out task and temporal shortcuts, we evaluate the probes under same-task, same-timestep matched comparisons: Pi0.5 probes still reach roughly 92% pairwise ordering accuracy, while label-shuffled controls stay at chance. Used as a test-time selector over sampled Pi0.5 action prefixes, the same probe turns this offline finding into behavior: on push-plate, success rises from 26.7% under greedy decoding to 44.3%, with a second positive case on wine-rack. The gains are not universal and require additional inference compute, but the underlying finding is clean: frozen VLAs already encode information about success that their imitation objective never explicitly demands.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过模仿动作进行训练；其损失函数从未要求其估计奖励、进展或未来成功率。然而，其冻结的表示已蕴含此类信息，且无需重新训练策略即可从中读取并用于引导动作选择。基于LIBERO-Goal中混合成功与失败的操控轨迹，我们利用冻结特征上的轻量级线性探针恢复蒙特卡洛结果目标。这些目标可通过OpenVLA、Pi0.5、DINOv2及CLIP特征稳定预测，而基于进展、剩余时间、任务标识或本体感知的基线方法则显著难以预测。为排除任务与时间捷径，我们在相同任务、相同时间步的匹配比较中评估探针：Pi0.5探针仍能达到约92%的成对排序准确率，而标签随机打乱的对照组仅保持随机水平。将该探针作为测试时选择器作用于采样得到的Pi0.5动作前缀后，离线发现转化为实际行为：在推板任务中，成功率从贪婪解码下的26.7%提升至44.3%，并在酒架任务中呈现第二个正向案例。增益并非普适且需额外推理计算，但核心发现清晰明确：冻结的VLA已编码其模仿目标从未明确要求的成功相关信息。

Authors: Jiachen Zhang, Junnan Nie, Junyi Lao, Wei Cheng, Chenghao Liu, Jiaxin Jiang, Songfang Huang

Mag-VLA: Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Magnetically Actuated Microrobot Manipulation Manipulation

Vision-Language-Action microrobot manipulation bimanual coordination Action Chunking Transformer LoRA

简要说明：提出了Mag-VLA，一种用于双臂磁性微型机器人操作的VLA模型，采用Qwen2.5-VL骨干网络、运动感知相位分类器和相位条件ACT解码器实现协调控制。

TLDR: Proposes Mag-VLA, a VLA model for bimanual magnetic microrobot manipulation, using a Qwen2.5-VL backbone, motion-aware phase classifier, and phase-conditioned ACT decoder to achieve coordinated control.

Abstract: Magnetically actuated microrobots have been used as wireless, non-contact manipulation tools at microscales, making them promising for minimally invasive applications. However, their control remains challenging due to indirect actuation, limited sensing, and nonlinear magnetic interactions. In this work, we propose Mag-VLA, a vision-language-action (VLA) model for dexterous magnetic microrobot manipulation using two robotic arms with mounted magnets for dynamic magnetic-field construction. Bimanual coordination enables capabilities such as microrobot reorientation that are difficult or infeasible with a single arm, but it also introduces coupled control challenges, as the policy must generate coordinated trajectories for both actuators within a shared workspace. Our framework adapts a Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to process visual observations and language instructions for action prediction. To capture task progression, we introduce a motion-aware phase classifier and a phase-conditioned Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) decoder for temporally coherent multi-step control. We further construct a teleoperated magnetic microrobot manipulation dataset covering three task configurations. Ablation studies show that the ACT-based decoder substantially outperforms alternative generative action heads. In real-robot experiments, Mag-VLA achieves a 90% approach success rate across all tasks and transport success rates of 80%, 70%, and 50% as task difficulty increases. These results demonstrate that hierarchical VLA modeling provides a promising framework for magnetic microrobot manipulation.

摘要（中文）：摘要：磁驱动微型机器人已被用作微尺度下的无线非接触操控工具，在微创应用中展现出广阔前景。然而，由于间接驱动、有限感知以及非线性磁相互作用，其控制仍具挑战性。本研究提出Mag-VLA——一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，利用两只安装磁铁的机械臂构建动态磁场，实现对磁性微型机器人的灵巧操控。双手协调使微型机器人重新定向等单臂难以实现或不可行的功能成为可能，但同时也带来了耦合控制难题：策略必须在共享工作空间内为两个执行器生成协调轨迹。我们的框架采用Qwen2.5-VL-7B主干网络，通过低秩自适应（LoRA）处理视觉观测和语言指令以预测动作。为捕捉任务进展，我们引入了运动感知阶段分类器，并设计了基于阶段条件的动作分块Transformer（ACT）解码器，用于实现时间连贯的多步控制。此外，我们构建了一个涵盖三种任务配置的遥操作磁性微型机器人操作数据集。消融实验表明，基于ACT的解码器显著优于其他生成式动作头模块。真实机器人实验中，Mag-VLA在所有任务中的接近成功率达90%，并随任务难度提升分别实现了80%、70%和50%的运输成功率。这些结果表明，分层式VLA建模为磁性微型机器人操控提供了有前景的框架。

Authors: Yongchen Wang, Kangyi Lu, Lan Wei, Dandan Zhang

Self-Supervised Online Robot-Agnostic Traversability Estimation for Open-World Environments Locomotion

self-supervised traversability estimation online learning robot-agnostic multimodal proprioceptive-inertial diversity-aware replay memory

简要说明：COTRATE 是一个在线自监督框架，通过机器人无关的地形评估模块和视觉对齐损失，使机器人能够从多模态无标签经验中持续估计可通行性，并支持跨平台知识迁移。

TLDR: COTRATE is an online self-supervised framework that enables robots to continuously estimate traversability from multimodal unlabeled experience using a robot-agnostic terrain assessment module and a visual alignment loss, supporting knowledge transfer across platforms.

Abstract: Self-supervised online traversability estimation enables robots to continuously learn from unlabeled open-world experiences and adapt their navigation behavior toward safe and efficient trajectories. Existing approaches either rely on handcrafted proprioceptive traversability scores, limiting robot-agnosticism, or cluster prior data, preventing online learning. Moreover, many continual learning methods incur substantial memory and computational costs, hindering onboard deployment. We introduce COTRATE, an online learning framework for continuous traversability estimation from multimodal, unlabeled robot experience. Our method first infers robust traversability scores using a robot-agnostic, learning-based online terrain assessment module operating on proprioceptiveand inertial signals. These scores then supervise a visual traversability network through a novel alignment loss that associates visual embeddings with online terrain assessments.To mitigate forgetting during continual learning with minimal overhead, we propose a diversity-aware feature selection strategythat preserves performance using a compact replay memory. We further show that the learned traversability representation supports knowledge transfer across different robot platforms with different locomotion kinematics. We evaluate COTRATE on a dataset of \approx 50,000 images collected with two robotic platforms across 11 outdoor terrains, and benchmark it on navigation tasks in three representative outdoor environments. We make the dataset, code, and trained models publicly available.

摘要（中文）：自监督在线可通行性估计使机器人能够持续从未标注的开放世界经验中学习，并调整其导航行为以实现安全高效的轨迹规划。现有方法要么依赖手工设计的本体感知可通行性评分（限制了机器人无关性），要么对先验数据进行聚类（阻碍了在线学习）。此外，许多持续学习方法需要大量内存和计算成本，阻碍了机载部署。我们提出COTRATE——一种从多模态无标注机器人经验中实现连续可通行性估计的在线学习框架。该方法首先通过基于学习的机器人无关在线地形评估模块，利用本体感知与惯性信号推断鲁棒的可通行性评分；随后利用新型对齐损失（将视觉嵌入与在线地形评估关联）来监督视觉可通行性网络。为在最小开销下缓解持续学习中的遗忘问题，我们提出一种多样性感知特征选择策略，通过紧凑的重放记忆保持性能。进一步研究表明，所学习的可通行性表示支持跨不同运动学特性的机器人平台的知识迁移。我们在两台机器人平台于11种户外地形采集的约50,000张图像数据集上评估COTRATE，并在三个代表性户外环境的导航任务中进行基准测试。我们公开了数据集、代码及训练模型。

Authors: Julia Hindel, Simon Bultmann, Houman Masnavi, Daniele Cattaneo, Abhinav Valada

Tactile-Proprioceptive Sensor Fusion for Contact Wrench Estimation in Whole-Body Physical Human-Robot Interaction Manipulation

tactile-proprioceptive fusion contact wrench estimation physical human-robot interaction temporal convolutional network robotic skin

简要说明：本文提出了一种触觉-本体感觉传感器融合框架，利用气动皮肤垫和电机电流本体感觉来估计物理人机交互中的多轴接触力，并在真实机器人手臂上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a tactile-proprioceptive sensor fusion framework using pneumatic skin pads and motor-current proprioception to estimate multi-axis contact forces during physical human-robot interaction, validated on a real robot arm.

Abstract: Direct physical guidance is a natural means of teaching and interacting with robots, and robotic skins make a key contribution by enabling sensitive contact sensing and localization. This paper presents a tactile-proprioceptive sensor fusion framework for natural physical human-robot interaction. Tactile cues from pneumatic skin pads serve as contact indicators that bypass the ambiguity between frictional residues and applied external forces, enabling highly sensitive contact detection without explicit friction identification. We fuse these cues with motor-current-based proprioception to reconstruct multi-axis contact forces on the robot surface. To maintain accuracy during motion, we employ a temporal convolutional network (TCN) to mitigate friction hysteresis during stick-slip transitions, reducing uncertainty at contact onset and yielding smooth, responsive guidance. We validate the approach on a skin-integrated robot arm: (i) multi-axis forces are reconstructed in stationary contacts, and (ii) simultaneous force estimation and kinesthetic teaching are demonstrated. Results indicate improved sensitivity and responsiveness across diverse contact conditions compared with tactile-only and proprioceptive-only baselines, supporting tactile-proprioceptive fusion as a reliable pathway to safe, intuitive physical human-robot interaction.

摘要（中文）：直接物理引导是人机教学与交互的一种自然手段，而机器人皮肤通过实现灵敏的接触感知与定位发挥着关键作用。本文提出了一种面向自然物理人机交互的触觉-本体感知融合框架。来自气动皮肤垫的触觉信号作为接触指示器，可消除摩擦残留与施加外力之间的歧义，无需显式摩擦识别即可实现高灵敏度接触检测。我们将这些触觉信号与基于电机电流的本体感知相融合，以重构机器人表面的多轴接触力。为保持运动过程中的精度，我们采用时序卷积网络（TCN）来抑制粘滑过渡阶段的摩擦迟滞效应，从而降低接触起始时刻的不确定性，实现平滑响应的引导。我们在集成皮肤的机器人手臂上验证了该方法：（i）在静态接触条件下重构多轴力，（ii）同时展示了力估计与动觉教学。结果表明，与仅依赖触觉或仅依赖本体感知的基线方法相比，该方法在多种接触条件下均提升了灵敏度与响应性，验证了触觉-本体感知融合作为实现安全、直观物理人机交互的可靠途径。

Authors: Junha Min, Junghyeon Ma, Jiwung Kwon, Sunggyu Bae, Joohyung Kim, Kyungseo Park

Natural Locomotion: Principle and Method Locomotion

natural locomotion passive dynamics nonholonomic systems propulsion-oscillator exchange natural locomotion manifold

简要说明：提出自然运动的理论原理，基于振荡器与推进交换且平均功率为零，并在非完整系统中验证。

TLDR: Proposes a theoretical principle for natural locomotion based on oscillator-propulsion exchange and zero mean power, demonstrated on nonholonomic systems.

Abstract: Robotic locomotion can become efficient when mechanisms exploit passive dynamics, compliance, and resonance rather than track prescribed trajectories. This paper formulates natural locomotion as an exchange principle for systems whose motion is mediated by environmental constraints or interactions. A motion is natural when an internal oscillator returns periodically, the body pose drifts, and the mean Propulsion--Oscillator Exchange power (POE power) vanishes over one cycle. The selected family is a Natural Locomotion Manifold (NLM). We develop the conservative realization of this principle for continuous ideal environmental constraints: the constraints do no external work, total mechanical energy is conserved, and zero mean POE power is an internal exchange with the environment-mediated propulsive channel, not external energy input. The method is a closed/open construction. The propulsive channel is first closed to reveal an effective internal oscillator, organized by scalar action-angle structure in one effective degree of freedom or by nonlinear modal sectors in several degrees of freedom. The channel is then reopened, pose is reconstructed, and accepted cycles must preserve internal recurrence and zero mean POE power. We demonstrate the principle on two ideal nonholonomic no-slip systems: a Chaplygin-sleigh / pendulum-driven car and a three-body extension. In the scalar case, POE closure is equivalent to the missing internal return condition, giving a theorem-backed computation of the NLM family. In the multi-degree case, POE closure remains necessary but must be completed by modal identity, internal return, dynamics consistency, same fixed passive architecture, and nonzero displacement. Natural locomotion becomes a design question: which passive architectures support no, one, or several certified NLM families?

摘要（中文）：摘要： 当运动机制利用被动动力学、柔顺性和共振而非跟踪预定轨迹时，机器人 locomotion 可以达到高效。本文将自然运动表述为一种交换原理，适用于其运动由环境约束或相互作用介导的系统。当内部振荡器周期性回归、身体位姿发生漂移，且一个周期内平均推进-振荡器交换功率（POE功率）为零时，该运动即为自然运动。所选运动族称为自然运动流形（NLM）。针对连续理想环境约束，我们发展了该原理的保守实现方式：约束不做外部功，总机械能守恒，且零平均POE功率是与环境介导推进通道的内部交换，而非外部能量输入。 该方法采用封闭/开放结构。首先封闭推进通道，以揭示一个有效内部振荡器——该振荡器在单自由度情形下由标量作用-角结构组织，在多自由度情形下由非线性模态扇区组织。随后重新开放通道，重建位姿，且可接受的周期必须保持内部循环性与零平均POE功率。 我们在两个理想非完整无滑移系统上演示了该原理：一个是恰普雷金雪橇/摆驱动小车，另一个是三体扩展系统。在标量情形下，POE封闭等价于缺失的内部回归条件，从而为NLM族的计算提供了基于定理的支持。在多自由度情形下，POE封闭仍是必要条件，但必须辅以模态同一性、内部回归、动力学一致性、相同被动结构以及非零位移。自然运动由此成为设计问题：何种被动结构支持无、一个或多个经过认证的NLM族？

Authors: Mirado Mortel, Luc Jaulin, Lionel Lapierre, Simon Rohou

SANTS: A State-Adaptive Scheduler for World Action Models Manipulation

State-adaptive scheduler World Action Models denoising-depth scan video-to-action diffusion latency reduction

简要说明：本文提出SANTS，一种用于世界动作模型中视频到动作扩散策略的状态自适应调度器，通过动态调整去噪深度来平衡动作质量和推理效率，在模拟和真实机器人任务上实现高成功率并大幅降低延迟。

TLDR: This paper introduces SANTS, a state-adaptive scheduler for video-to-action diffusion policies in World Action Models, which dynamically adjusts denoising depth to balance action quality and inference efficiency, achieving high success rates with significant latency reduction on both simulated and real robot tasks.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot manipulation by using video-based future representations to condition action generation. In pixel-space WAMs, however, the best action condition is not necessarily the fully denoised video. Controlled denoising-depth scans show that video refinement can reduce action error up to a state-dependent point, after which the gain may saturate or even reverse when late predictions become less action-relevant or physically unreliable. This suggests that action generation should use a state-dependent point along the video noise trajectory rather than a fixed terminal denoising depth. We introduce State-Adaptive Noise Trajectory Scheduler (SANTS), a lightweight scheduler for video-to-action diffusion policies. At each video decision point, SANTS reads the current video-state representation and noise level, then jointly predicts a cumulative stopping hazard and a relative noise-progression ratio. SANTS is post-trained with a path-level reward computed after the frozen action branch generates the final action chunk, so the scheduler is optimized for downstream action quality rather than intermediate video fidelity, while redundant video-state updates are explicitly penalized. Experiments show that SANTS reaches \(94.4\%\) overall success on RoboTwin 2.0 and \(73.1\%\) average success across seven real-robot tasks, while reducing latency by \(81.7\%\) and \(79.0\%\) relative to full video denoising, respectively. These results indicate that adaptive selection along the video noise trajectory can preserve the control benefits of WAM-style future reasoning while removing much of its redundant inference cost.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过利用基于视频的未来表征来调控动作生成，从而提升机器人操作能力。然而，在像素空间WAM中，最优动作条件并非总是完全去噪的视频。受控去噪深度扫描实验表明：视频细化能将动作误差降低至某个状态依赖点，此后当后期预测与动作相关性减弱或物理可靠性下降时，去噪增益可能趋于饱和甚至逆转为负。这表明动作生成应沿视频噪声轨迹采用状态依赖节点，而非固定的终端去噪深度。为此，我们提出状态自适应噪声轨迹调度器（SANTS）——一种面向视频到动作扩散策略的轻量级调度器。在每个视频决策节点，SANTS读取当前视频状态表征与噪声水平，联合预测累积停止风险与相对噪声演进比例。SANTS通过冻结动作分支生成最终动作片段后的路径级奖励进行后训练，因此调度器优化目标为下游动作质量而非中间视频保真度，同时显式惩罚冗余的视频状态更新。实验表明：SANTS在RoboTwin 2.0上达到94.4%的整体成功率，在七项真实机器人任务中平均成功率达73.1%，同时相较于完整视频去噪分别降低81.7%和79.0%的延迟。这些结果表明，沿视频噪声轨迹的自适应选择既能保留WAM式未来推理的控制优势，又能大幅消除其冗余推理成本。

Authors: Yirui Sun, Guangyu Zhuge, Keliang Liu, Jie Gu, Xinyu Bing, Zhongxue Gan, Chunxu Tian

S-Cheetah: A Novel Quadrupedal Robot with a 3-DOF Active Spine Learning Agile Locomotion Locomotion

quadrupedal robot active spine reinforcement learning agile locomotion gallop gait

简要说明：提出了S-Cheetah，一种具有三自由度主动脊柱的四足机器人，通过专门的强化学习框架实现了高速奔驰、敏捷转向和空中自翻正能力。

TLDR: Presents S-Cheetah, a quadrupedal robot with a 3-DOF active spine that uses a tailored reinforcement learning framework to achieve high-speed galloping, agile turning, and aerial self-righting.

Abstract: The biological spine of quadrupeds enables sagittal flexion/extension, lateral bending, and axial rotation, playing a crucial role in highly agile and dexterous locomotion. While numerous studies have integrated active spinal joints into quadrupedal robots to enhance agility, most designs simplify control complexity by reducing spinal degrees of freedom (DOF), failing to achieve the spatial tri-axial rotation characteristic of biological spines. Consequently, replicating a multi-DOF biomimetic spine and effectively leveraging it to empower the agile locomotion of quadrupedal robots remains a significant research challenge. In this study, we present S-Cheetah, a quadrupedal robot featuring a 3-DOF bio-inspired serial active spine capable of biomimetic spatial tri-axial rotation. To empower the robot to fully utilize this active spine, we developed a specialized reinforcement learning framework to actively promote the engagement of the introduced spine and maximize the robot's locomotive capabilities by integrating an acceleration curriculum learning strategy with tailored reward functions, such as a gallop gait reward, a spine undulation reward, and a spine steering reward. Experimental results demonstrate that S-Cheetah can achieve a peak speed of 6.9 m/s using the rotary G2 gallop gait and an in-place turning rate of 7.2 rad/s. Besides, the system exhibits an emergent, feline-inspired aerial self-righting capability, allowing it to land stably on four feet from arbitrary orientations during free fall. Finally, through extensive evaluations across diverse locomotion tasks, we prove that the introduction of the proposed 3-DOF spine comprehensively enhances the locomotive agility of quadrupedal robots. Project website: himmy-robotics.github.io/scheetah

摘要（中文）：四足动物的生物脊柱具备矢状屈伸、侧向弯曲和轴向旋转功能，对其实现高度敏捷灵巧的运动至关重要。尽管已有诸多研究将主动脊柱关节集成到四足机器人中以提升敏捷性，但大多数设计通过减少脊柱自由度来简化控制复杂度，未能实现生物脊柱的空间三轴旋转特性。因此，复现具有多自由度的仿生脊柱并有效利用它来增强四足机器人的敏捷运动能力，仍然是一项重要的研究挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了S-Cheetah——一款配备3自由度仿生串联主动脊柱的四足机器人，该脊柱能够实现仿生空间三轴旋转。为使机器人充分利用这一主动脊柱，我们开发了专门的强化学习框架，通过整合加速度课程学习策略与定制奖励函数（包括疾驰步态奖励、脊柱波动奖励和脊柱转向奖励），积极促进引入脊柱的参与度并最大化机器人的运动能力。实验结果表明，S-Cheetah使用旋转G2疾驰步态可实现6.9米/秒的峰值速度，原地转弯速率达7.2弧度/秒。此外，该系统展现出一种新兴的、受猫科动物启发的空中自翻转能力，使其在自由落体过程中能够从任意姿态稳定地四足落地。最终，通过跨多种运动任务的广泛评估，我们证明了所提出的3自由度脊柱的引入全面增强了四足机器人的运动敏捷性。项目网站：himmy-robotics.github.io/scheetah

Authors: Zimu Li, Weibang Bai

Turning Video Models into Generalist Robot Policies WorldModel

video world model inverse dynamics model cross-embodiment zero-shot robot control decoupled video-to-action

简要说明：本文提出了VERA，一种将视频生成与动作预测解耦的机器人策略，使用无动作视频世界模型和特定具身的逆动力学模型，实现了零样本跨具身控制和数据高效训练。

TLDR: This paper introduces VERA, a robot policy that decouples video generation from action prediction by using an action-free video world model and an embodiment-specific inverse dynamics model, enabling zero-shot cross-embodiment control and data-efficient training.

Abstract: Video generative models have emerged as a promising robotics backbone, capable of generating videos that depict the completion of complex tasks across embodiments and environments. Recent work proposes robot foundation models that jointly predict future observations and actions by finetuning video models with action-labeled data. In this paper, we test the limits of an alternative approach: leave the video planner as-is while training an embodiment-specific inverse dynamics model (IDM). This decoupling offers several natural benefits: the video planner remains embodiment-agnostic, different video models can be interchanged easily without re-training the IDM, and the IDM can be independently trained with readily available self-play data. We present a closed-loop, video-to-action policy that combines an action-free video world model with a carefully-designed IDM based on the robot embodiment Jacobian. We demonstrate that our IDM design is both data-efficient and scalable to high-dimensional action spaces. Our policy, which we coin the Video-to-Embodied Robot Action Model (VERA), achieves strong performance across simulated and real-world benchmarks, including zero-shot Panda arm manipulation and 16-DoF Allegro-hand dexterous cube re-orientation. The same video planner can be used across multiple embodiments by pairing it with different embodiment-specific IDMs. Our results show that decoupled video planning plus faithful video-to-action translation is a viable alternative route towards zero-shot, cross-embodiment, and generalizable robot control. More results are available on our project website: https://vera.csail.mit.edu.

摘要（中文）：视频生成模型已成为一种前景广阔的机器人基础架构，能够生成描绘跨具身形态与环境完成复杂任务的视频。近期研究提出了机器人基础模型，通过使用带有动作标注的数据对视频模型进行微调，从而联合预测未来观测与动作。本文测试了一种替代方法的极限：保持视频规划器不变，同时训练针对特定具身形态的逆动力学模型（IDM）。这种解耦设计具有若干天然优势：视频规划器保持具身无关性，不同视频模型可在无需重新训练IDM的情况下轻松互换，且IDM可利用现成的自对弈数据独立训练。我们提出了一种闭环的视频到动作策略，该策略将无动作视频世界模型与基于机器人具身雅可比矩阵精心设计的IDM相结合。实验表明，我们的IDM设计兼具数据高效性与高维动作空间的可扩展性。我们将该策略命名为视频到具身机器人动作模型（VERA），在模拟与真实世界基准测试中均展现出卓越性能，包括零样本Panda机械臂操作及16自由度Allegro灵巧手立方体重新定向任务。通过为不同具身形态配对专属IDM，同一视频规划器可跨多种具身形态使用。研究结果表明，解耦式视频规划结合高保真视频到动作映射，是迈向零样本、跨具身及可泛化机器人控制的可行替代路径。更多结果详见项目网站：https://vera.csail.mit.edu。

Authors: Sizhe Lester Li, Evan Kim, Xingjian Bai, Tong Zhao, Tao Pang, Max Simchowitz, Vincent Sitzmann

Colosseum V2: Benchmarking Generalization for Vision Language Action Models VLA

VLA generalization simulation benchmark robot manipulation distribution shift ManiSkill simulator

简要说明：Colosseum V2 是一个大规模仿真基准，用于评估视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在分布变化下的机器人操作泛化能力，揭示了性能差距并提供了标准化的任务、指标和评估协议。

TLDR: Colosseum V2 is a large-scale simulation benchmark for evaluating the generalization of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in robotic manipulation under distribution shifts, revealing performance gaps and providing standardized tasks, metrics, and protocols.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate promising generalization in robotic manipulation, driven by advances in large-scale vision and language pre-training. This progress can be misleading. Despite the zero-shot perception and language capabilities of VLAs, their overall task performance often degrades under distribution shifts, revealing gaps in how these systems translate high-level understanding into robust behavior. To systematically study this gap, we introduce Colosseum V2, a large-scale simulation benchmark for evaluating VLA generalization in robot learning across diverse conditions. The benchmark comprises 28 tasks spanning 13 task categories and two robot morphologies, covering a wide range of manipulation primitives and long-horizon behaviors. Built on the ManiSkill simulator, Colosseum V2 enables fast, GPU-parallelized evaluation and supports both in-domain and out-of-domain testing at scale. We evaluate state-of-the-art methods, including Action Chunking Transformers (ACT) and Pi0.5, and reveal limitations in both base performance and generalization. We demonstrate strong correlations between simulation and real-world metrics that support the ecological validity of the benchmark. By standardizing tasks, metrics, and evaluation protocols within a unified benchmark, Colosseum V2 enables reproducible and fair comparisons, reduced evaluation overhead, and accelerated progress toward general-purpose robot policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域展现出良好的泛化能力，这得益于大规模视觉与语言预训练的进展。然而这一进步可能具有误导性：尽管VLA模型具备零样本感知与语言能力，但其整体任务性能在分布偏移条件下常常下降，揭示了这些系统在将高层理解转化为鲁棒行为时存在的鸿沟。为系统研究这一鸿沟，我们提出Colosseum V2——一个用于评估机器人学习领域中VLA泛化能力的大规模仿真基准测试平台。该基准涵盖28项任务，分布于13个任务类别和两种机器人形态，覆盖广泛的操作基元与长时域行为。基于ManiSkill仿真器构建的Colosseum V2支持快速GPU并行化评估，并能在规模化场景下同时进行域内与域外测试。我们评估了包括动作分块变换器（ACT）和Pi0.5在内的当前最优方法，揭示了其在基础性能与泛化能力两方面的局限。实验表明，仿真指标与真实世界指标之间存在强相关性，验证了该基准的生态效度。通过在统一基准中标准化任务、度量标准与评估协议，Colosseum V2实现了可复现的公平比较，降低了评估开销，并加速了通向通用机器人策略的进程。

Authors: Jeremy Morgan, Prajwal Vijay, Hyeonho Oh, Jincen Song, Ashvin Arora, Alina Du, Gaurav Sukhatme, Jesse Thomason, Ishika Singh

HumanoidMimicGen: Data Generation for Loco-Manipulation via Whole-Body Planning HumanoidEmbodied

imitation learning data generation loco-manipulation whole-body planning humanoid robot

简要说明：HumanoidMimicGen通过全身规划从少量源演示自动生成大规模人形机器人移动操作示范，使得模仿学习策略的性能比仅使用真实数据训练的模型高出20%。

TLDR: HumanoidMimicGen automatically generates large-scale humanoid loco-manipulation demonstrations from a few source demos using whole-body planning, enabling imitation learning policies that outperform those trained only on real data.

Abstract: Imitation learning is a promising approach for training humanoid robots to both walk and manipulate, but it requires a large number of demonstrations, which are time-intensive and difficult to collect via teleoperation. Existing data-generation algorithms can automatically synthesize demonstrations for manipulators, but they are ineffective on humanoids because their high-dimensional composite action spaces involve arms, legs, and torsos. We present HumanoidMimicGen, a method for generating humanoid legged loco-manipulation data. Our method adapts contact-rich whole-body skills from a handful of source demonstrations to new states, generalizing across changes in object pose. By interleaving these single- and dual-arm skills with whole-body locomotion and manipulation planning, the method generates stable, collision-free data across diverse scenes and layouts. To evaluate our approach, we introduce a new simulated loco-manipulation benchmark containing nine diverse tasks that test humanoid loco-manipulation capabilities. There, we demonstrate that HumanoidMimicGen automatically generates large datasets for imitation learning and enables a systematic study of how data generation and policy learning decisions impact model performance. We show that whole-body visuomotor policies co-trained with data generated by HumanoidMimicGen outperform those trained only on real-world data by 20%.

摘要（中文）：模仿学习是训练类人机器人实现行走与操作功能的可行方法，但其需要大量示范数据，而通过远程操控收集这些数据既耗时又困难。现有数据生成算法可自动合成机械臂的示范数据，但难以应用于类人机器人，因其高维复合动作空间涉及手臂、腿部与躯干。本文提出HumanoidMimicGen方法，用于生成类人机器人腿部全身操作数据。该方法从少量源示范中提取富含接触的全身技能，并将其迁移至新状态，同时实现对物体位姿变化的泛化。通过将单臂与双臂技能与全身移动操作规划交替结合，该方法可在多样场景与布局中生成稳定无碰撞的数据。为评估所提方法，我们引入新的模拟全身操作基准测试，包含九项多样化任务以检验类人机器人全身操作能力。实验表明，HumanoidMimicGen可自动生成大规模模仿学习数据集，并系统揭示数据生成与策略学习决策对模型性能的影响。与仅使用真实数据训练的模型相比，联合HumanoidMimicGen生成数据训练的全身视觉运动策略性能提升20%。

Authors: Kevin Lin, Ajay Mandlekar, Caelan Reed Garrett, Nikita Chernyadev, Yu Fang, Runyu Ding, Yuqi Xie, Justin Tran, Linxi Fan, Yuke Zhu

Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players WorldModel

multi-agent world model interactive video generation Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding Sparse Hub Attention causal rollout distillation

简要说明：Gamma-World 提出了一种用于交互式视频模拟的生成式多智能体世界模型，通过 Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding 和 Sparse Hub Attention 实现了可扩展、置换对称的多智能体控制及高效的跨智能体交互。

TLDR: Gamma-World introduces a generative multi-agent world model for interactive video simulation, featuring Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding and Sparse Hub Attention to achieve scalable, permutation-symmetric multi-agent control and efficient cross-agent interaction.

Abstract: World models for interactive video generation have largely focused on single-agent settings, where future observations are generated from a single control signal. However, many generated environments require multi-agent interaction: multiple players, robots, or embodied agents act simultaneously within a shared space. Scaling world models to such settings requires a principled multi-agent design: agents should remain independently controllable, permutation-symmetric, and support efficient inference while maintaining consistency across time and perspectives. In this paper, we present our generative multi-agent world model for interactive simulation. It introduces Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding, a parameter-free extension of 3D RoPE that represents agents as vertices of a regular simplex in rotary angle space. This gives each agent a distinct phase while making all agents permutation-equivalent, enabling scalable agent identity without learned per-slot identities or a fixed agent ordering. To avoid dense all-to-all attention across agents, we further propose Sparse Hub Attention, where learnable hub tokens mediate token interaction across agents, reducing cross-agent attention cost from quadratic to linear in the number of agents. For real-time rollout, we distill a full-context diffusion teacher into a causal student that generates temporal blocks sequentially with KV caching, enabling action-responsive generation at 24 FPS. Experiments in multiplayer virtual environments show that our model improves video fidelity, action controllability, and inter-agent consistency over slot-based and dense-attention baselines, while generalizing from two to four players without additional training.

摘要（中文）：用于交互式视频生成的世界模型主要聚焦于单智能体场景，即根据单一控制信号生成未来观测结果。然而，许多生成环境需要多智能体交互：多个玩家、机器人或具身智能体在同一共享空间内同时行动。将世界模型扩展至此类场景需要原则性的多智能体设计：智能体应保持独立可控、排列对称，并支持高效推理，同时确保时间维度与视角间的一致性。本文提出了一种面向交互式仿真的生成式多智能体世界模型。该模型引入**单纯形旋转智能体编码**（Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding），这是3D旋转位置编码（RoPE）的一种无需参数扩展的方法，它将智能体表示为旋转角度空间中正则单纯形的顶点。该方法在赋予每个智能体独立相位的同时，确保所有智能体排列等价，从而无需学习每个时隙的身份标识或固定的智能体排序即可实现可扩展的智能体身份表示。为避免智能体间密集的全连接注意力机制，我们进一步提出**稀疏枢纽注意力**（Sparse Hub Attention），其中可学习的枢纽令牌（hub tokens）作为媒介，调控跨智能体的令牌交互，将跨智能体注意力成本从智能体数量的二次方降低至线性。为实现实时推演，我们将全上下文扩散教师模型蒸馏为因果学生模型，该学生模型通过KV缓存顺序生成时间块，从而在24 FPS下实现响应动作的生成。在多玩家虚拟环境中的实验表明，相较于基于时隙和密集注意力的基线方法，我们的模型在视频保真度、动作可控性及智能体间一致性方面均取得提升，且无需额外训练即可将智能体数量从两个泛化至四个。

Authors: Fangfu Liu, Kai He, Tianchang Shen, Tianshi Cao, Sanja Fidler, Yueqi Duan, Jun Gao, Igor Gilitschenski, Zian Wang, Xuanchi Ren

Ω-QVLA: Robust Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models via Composite Rotation and Per-step Scaling VLA

post-training quantization W4A4 precision VLA models diffusion action head composite rotation

简要说明：一种无需训练的后训练量化框架，将 VLA 模型的 LLM 主干和扩散动作头统一压缩至 W4A4 精度，在降低内存占用的同时保持高任务成功率。

TLDR: A training-free post-training quantization framework that compresses both the LLM backbone and diffusion action head of VLA models to uniform W4A4 precision, achieving high task success rates with reduced memory footprint.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models unify perception, reasoning, and control within a single policy, yet their multi-billion-parameter backbones and diffusion-based action heads make on-device deployment prohibitively expensive. Prior quantization efforts offer only partial solutions, compressing the LLM backbone while leaving the DiT action head at full precision, or resorting to mixed-precision schemes, driven by the belief that uniformly quantizing the action head is inherently unstable. We challenge this assumption with Omega-QVLA, the first training-free post-training quantization framework that compresses both the language backbone and the entire diffusion action head of a VLA model to a uniform W4A4 precision, eliminating the need for mixed-precision allocation. Omega-QVLA combines a composite SVD-Hadamard rotation that equalizes per-channel weight energy while diffusing residual activation outliers with per-step DiT activation scaling quantization that absorbs dynamic-range drift across denoising steps. On LIBERO, Omega-QVLA compresses Pi 0.5 and GR00T N1.5 to W4A4 with 98.0% and 87.8% task success rates, matching or exceeding their FP16 references of 97.1% and 87.0%, while reducing the static memory footprint by 71.3%. Real-world manipulation experiments further confirm smooth, accurate manipulation where prior methods fail. Code is available at https://github.com/UCMP13753/Omega-QVLA.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将感知、推理与控制统一于单一策略之中，但其数十亿参数规模的骨干网络和基于扩散机制的动作头使得设备端部署成本过高。现有的量化方法仅提供部分解决方案：要么压缩大语言模型骨干网络而保留DiT动作头的全精度，要么采用混合精度方案——这源于一种普遍认知，即认为对动作头进行统一量化本质上是不稳定的。我们提出的Omega-QVLA挑战了这一假设。这是首个无需训练的微调后量化框架，能够将VLA模型的语言骨干网络与完整扩散动作头统一压缩至W4A4精度，从而消除混合精度分配的需求。Omega-QVLA结合了复合SVD-哈达玛旋转（可均衡各通道权重能量并扩散残差激活异常值）与逐步DiT激活缩放量化（可吸收去噪步骤中的动态范围漂移）。在LIBERO数据集上，Omega-QVLA将Pi 0.5和GR00T N1.5压缩至W4A4精度，任务成功率分别达到98.0%和87.8%，与或超越其FP16基准的97.1%和87.0%，同时将静态内存占用降低71.3%。实物操控实验进一步证实：在先前方法失效的场景下，Omega-QVLA仍能实现流畅且精准的操控。代码开源地址：https://github.com/UCMP13753/Omega-QVLA。

Authors: Xinyu Wang, Mingze Li, Sicheng Lyu, Dongxiu Liu, Kaicheng Yang, Ziyu Zhao, Yufei Cui, Xiao-Wen Chang, Peng Lu

GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence VLA

depth map generation generative-supervised pre-training embodied vision-language model Vision-Language-Action benchmark dataset

简要说明：GEM在VLM预训练中引入深度图生成任务，弥合高层语义与低层空间推理之间的差距，在具身智能基准上取得SOTA性能，并提升了部署的VLA动作模型。

TLDR: GEM introduces a depth map generation task during VLM pre-training to bridge high-level semantics and low-level spatial reasoning for embodied intelligence, achieving SOTA on embodied benchmarks and improving a deployed VLA action model.

Abstract: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance and generalization in robotics, particularly within Vision-Language-Action frameworks. However, a significant gap remains between the high-level semantic focus of standard text-guided pre-training paradigms and the low-level spatial and physical knowledge critical for execution in embodied environments. In this paper, we introduce GEM, a Generative-supervised Embodied vision-language Model designed to bridge this divide. We propose integrating a depth map generation task directly into the VLM pre-training phase. By training this generative objective jointly with the main model, we observe substantial improvements in embodied intelligence, significantly enhancing both semantic understanding and physical operation capabilities. To support this paradigm, we curate and release GEM-4M, a comprehensive large-scale dataset featuring a mixture of grounding, reasoning, and planning data paired with high-quality depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEM achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse embodied benchmarks. Furthermore, our deployed action model, GEM-VLA, exhibits vastly superior task execution abilities in both simulation environments and real-world evaluations. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://zhaorw02.github.io/GEM/

摘要（中文）：具身视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在机器人领域，尤其是视觉-语言-动作框架中，已展现出卓越的性能与泛化能力。然而，标准文本引导预训练范式所侧重的高层语义，与具身环境中执行关键所需的底层空间及物理知识之间，仍存在显著差距。本文提出GEM（生成式监督具身视觉-语言模型），旨在弥合这一鸿沟。我们提出将深度图生成任务直接集成至VLM预训练阶段。通过将该生成目标与主模型联合训练，我们观察到具身智能的显著提升，语义理解与物理操作能力均得到大幅增强。为支撑该范式，我们构建并发布了GEM-4M——一个包含基础、推理与规划数据混合的大规模综合数据集，并配有高质量深度监督。大量实验表明，GEM在多种具身基准测试中均达到最优结果。此外，我们部署的动作模型GEM-VLA在仿真环境与真实世界评估中均展现出卓越的任务执行能力。代码、模型与数据集已开源至https://zhaorw02.github.io/GEM/。

Authors: Ruowen Zhao, Bangguo Li, Zuyan Liu, Yinan Liang, Junliang Ye, Fangfu Liu, Diankun Wu, Zhengyi Wang, Xumin Yu, Yongming Rao, Han Hu, Jun Zhu

DriveWAM: Video Generative Priors Enable Scalable World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

world-action modeling video generative priors flow-matching objective end-to-end autonomous driving KV memory selective caching

简要说明：DriveWAM 将预训练的视频扩散 transformer 适配为自回归的视频-动作策略，用于自动驾驶，通过统一的时序 token 序列和联合流匹配目标，实现了强大的规划性能并展示了扩展潜力。

TLDR: DriveWAM adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer into an autoregressive video-action policy for autonomous driving, using a unified temporal token sequence and joint flow-matching objective, achieving strong planning performance and demonstrating scaling potential.

Abstract: Pretrained foundation models have become an important basis for end-to-end autonomous driving. In contrast to vision-language models pretrained primarily on static image-text pairs, video generative models capture temporal dynamics and motion priors that are naturally suited for driving. We present DriveWAM, a driving world-action model that adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer into an autoregressive video-action policy. DriveWAM organizes video and action streams into a unified temporal token sequence and trains them under a joint flow-matching objective, preserving the pretrained video-generation architecture while adapting its large-scale video priors to action generation. To incorporate high-level scene understanding, we introduce scene-evolving driving guidance, where a frozen VLM produces chunk-specific semantic intent to guide video-action generation. To keep long-horizon rollout bounded, we further introduce selective KV memory, which maintains bounded modality-aware video and action memory pools through relevance-redundancy cache selection at inference time. Experiments on NAVSIM and the PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles benchmark show that DriveWAM achieves strong planning performance, and a data-scaling study from 4k to 100k driving clips further confirms the scaling potential of world-action modeling for end-to-end autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：预训练基础模型已成为端到端自动驾驶的重要基础。与主要基于静态图文对预训练的视觉语言模型不同，视频生成模型能够捕获天然适配驾驶任务的时间动态与运动先验知识。我们提出DriveWAM——一种驾驶世界-动作模型，它将预训练视频扩散Transformer改造为自回归视频-动作策略。DriveWAM将视频流与动作流组织为统一的时间令牌序列，并在联合流匹配目标下进行训练，在保留预训练视频生成架构的同时，将其大规模视频先验知识迁移至动作生成。为融入高层场景理解，我们引入场景演进驾驶引导机制：冻结的VLM生成片段级语义意图以指导视频-动作生成。为保持长时程推演的边界可控，我们进一步提出选择性KV记忆机制，通过推理时的相关-冗余缓存选择策略，维护具有模态感知能力的有限容量视频与动作记忆池。在NAVSIM与PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles基准上的实验表明，DriveWAM实现了出色的规划性能，而4k至100k驾驶片段的数据规模缩放研究进一步验证了世界-动作建模在端到端自动驾驶中的扩展潜力。

Authors: Chen Shi, Jinrui Xu, Shaoshuai Shi, Kehua Sheng, Bo Zhang, Li Jiang

VLA-Hijack: A Transferable Patch Attack against Vision-Language-Action Models via Visual Proprioception Hijacking VLA

adversarial patch attack cross-architecture transferability visual proprioception VLA model black-box transferability

简要说明：本文提出VLA-Hijack，一种可迁移的对抗性补丁攻击，通过劫持视觉本体感知过程利用视觉-语言-动作模型的基本漏洞，实现了跨架构黑盒迁移的最新成果。

TLDR: This paper proposes VLA-Hijack, a transferable adversarial patch attack that exploits a fundamental vulnerability in Vision-Language-Action models by hijacking the visual proprioception process, achieving state-of-the-art cross-architecture black-box transferability.

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful generalist policies, their severe vulnerability to adversarial patches significantly hinders their deployment in safety-critical domains. Moreover, existing patch attacks primarily focus on white-box settings, heavily overfitting to the specific action output space of the target model, which results in poor cross-architecture transferability. To overcome this limitation, we propose VLA-Hijack, a unified adversarial framework that breaks the transferability bottleneck by exploiting a fundamental vulnerability identified in this work: before planning any motion, a VLA model must first use visual information to locate its own robotic arm within the environment. Targeting this shared visual self-localization process, our approach concurrently optimizes Attention-Guided Proprioceptive Suppression to inhibit the real robotic arm's features, and Multimodal Proprioceptive Injection to establish the patch as a surrogate "phantom embodiment". By alternating between semantic concept anchoring and visual prototype projection, VLA-Hijack effectively severs the semantic relationship between the agent's true embodiment and its control policy. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures (OpenVLA, UniVLA, and CronusVLA) demonstrate that VLA-Hijack achieves superior optimization efficiency in white-box settings and sets a new SOTA for cross-architecture and cross-domain black-box transferability.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽已成为强大的通用策略模型，但其对对抗性补丁的严重脆弱性极大阻碍了其在安全关键领域的部署。此外，现有补丁攻击主要聚焦于白盒场景，过度拟合目标模型的特定动作输出空间，导致跨架构可迁移性较差。为突破这一局限，本文提出VLA-Hijack——一种统一对抗框架，通过利用本工作中发现的基础性漏洞打破迁移性瓶颈：VLA模型在执行任何动作规划前，必须首先利用视觉信息在环境中定位自身机械臂。针对这一共有的视觉自定位过程，我们的方法同步优化注意力引导的本体抑制（抑制真实机械臂特征）与多模态本体注入（将补丁构建为替代性"幻象具身"）。通过交替进行语义概念锚定与视觉原型投影，VLA-Hijack有效切断了智能体真实具身形态与其控制策略之间的语义关联。在多种架构（OpenVLA、UniVLA和CronusVLA）上的大量实验表明，VLA-Hijack在白盒场景中实现了卓越的优化效率，并在跨架构与跨域黑盒迁移性方面达到了新的最优水平。

Authors: Jiyuan Fu, Kaixun Jiang, Jingkai Jia, Zhaoyu Chen, Xueyao Chen, Lingyi Hong, Shuyong Gao, Chenzhi Tan, Dingkang Yang, Wenqiang Zhang

What-If World: A Causal Benchmark for General World Models in Embodied Scenarios WorldModel

causal benchmark world models video generation physical consistency intervention accuracy

简要说明：提出了一个用于评估视频世界模型在物理干预准确性的因果基准（What-If World），结果显示最先进的模型在大多数因果任务上失败。

TLDR: Introduces a causal benchmark (What-If World) for evaluating video world models on physical intervention accuracy, showing that state-of-the-art models fail on most causal tasks.

Abstract: Video generation models are increasingly used as world simulators for tasks like driving and robotic manipulation. What matters in these settings is not whether a single video looks right, but whether the model's output changes when its input changes. We test this by giving a model two prompts describing the same scene with one physical detail varied, and checking whether the two videos diverge the way physics predicts. The wording difference between the prompts is small by design, since only one variable is changed, but the correct physical difference is not. A model that misses this can still produce two videos that each look plausible individually, and existing benchmarks score videos one at a time and cannot detect this failure. We introduce What-If World, 319 such prompt pairs built on real frames from nuScenes and DROID, organized by a taxonomy of six physical variables shared across driving and manipulation. Each pair is scored with APEO, a four-part rubric checking whether each video follows its prompt (Adherence), is physically consistent (Physics), preserves the shared scene (Environment), and ends in the correct difference (Outcome). Across nine state-of-the-art models, no system exceeds 52% on the paired score, and open-source models cluster near 28%. Every model tested fails on a large fraction of causal interventions, indicating substantial room before these models can reliably support action-conditioned simulation or model-based planning. Where models do score well, performance appears to track the visual prominence of the intervention rather than the tractability of its underlying physics. Some visually subtle interventions score as low as 14.2%, while visually pronounced ones reach 40.4%.

摘要（中文）：视频生成模型正越来越多地被用作驾驶和机器人操作等任务的“世界模拟器”。在此类场景中，关键不在于单个视频是否看起来合理，而在于模型的输出是否随其输入的变化而改变。我们通过向模型提供两个描述相同场景但物理细节不同的提示，并检验两个视频是否按照物理规律产生差异来验证这一点。提示之间的措辞差异被刻意设计得很小（仅改变一个变量），但正确的物理差异却不小。忽视这一点的模型仍能生成两个各自看起来合理的视频，而现有基准测试逐个评分视频，无法检测到这一缺陷。我们提出“What-If World”数据集，包含基于nuScenes和DROID真实帧构建的319个此类提示对，并按驾驶与操作共有的六类物理变量进行分类。每个提示对使用APEO评分——该评分体系包含四个部分，分别检查每个视频是否遵循提示（忠实度）、是否符合物理规律（物理性）、是否保持共享场景（环境性）以及是否产生正确的差异结果（结果性）。在九种最先进模型中，没有系统在成对评分上超过52%，开源模型则集中在28%附近。所有被测试模型在大量因果干预中失败，表明这些模型在可靠支持动作条件模拟或基于模型的规划之前仍有巨大提升空间。在模型表现较好的情况下，其性能似乎与干预的视觉显著性相关，而非底层物理问题的可处理性。某些视觉上不明显的干预得分低至14.2%，而视觉显著的干预可达40.4%。

Authors: Kunlin Cai, Rui Song, Jinghuai Zhang, Kaiyuan Zhang, Pranav Bodapati, Alicia Yu, Fnu Suya, Mohammad Rostami, Jiaqi Ma, Yuan Tian

Imitation Learning for Robot Assistance in Open Surgery: A Multi-Policy Evaluation on Suture Following Manipulation

imitation learning surgical robotics visual-motor policies VLA suture following

简要说明：本文针对外科医生-机器人协作缝合中的跟随任务，基准测试了四种模仿学习策略（ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA、π0），发现π0凭借预训练的视觉-语言骨干在数据效率、鲁棒性方面表现最佳，并在外科医生试验中达到92%的缝合完成率。

TLDR: This paper benchmarks four imitation learning policies (ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA, π0) for surgeon-robot collaborative suture following in open surgery, showing that π0 with a pretrained vision-language backbone achieves the best data efficiency, robustness, and a 92% stitch completion rate in a surgeon trial.

Abstract: This study presents the first evaluation of general-purpose imitation learning for surgeon-robot collaborative assistance in open surgery, targeting suture following: the grab-pull-release motion an assistant performs at every stitch. We collect 160 teleoperated demonstrations (32,374 frames) on an open-source robot arm, benchmark four architecturally diverse imitation learning policies (ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA, $π_0$) across 28 trained models evaluated in 32 configurations along three clinically motivated dimensions: dataset size, camera viewpoint, and background variation. Our results demonstrate that under ideal conditions, the four policies achieve $50$-$75\%$ task success, with depth error as the dominant failure mode across all architectures. Among all policies, $π_0$ achieves the strongest results with a pretrained vision-language backbone, demonstrating superior data efficiency, greater robustness to background variation, and smoother trajectories compatible with surgical workflow. When deployed in a surgeon-robot suturing trial, $π_0$ yields a $92\%$ stitch completion rate. These findings establish collaborative robotic assistance in open surgery as a feasible target for imitation learning and highlight depth perception and end-effector design as key priorities for clinical translation.

摘要（中文）：本研究首次对通用模仿学习在开放手术中实现外科医生-机器人协作辅助进行了评估，聚焦于缝合跟随任务：即助手在每次缝合时执行的“抓取-牵拉-释放”动作。我们利用开源机器人手臂采集了160次远程操控演示（共32,374帧），对四种结构各异的模仿学习策略（ACT、扩散策略、SmolVLA、$π_0$）进行了基准测试，涉及28个训练模型，并在32种配置下沿三个临床相关维度（数据集规模、摄像头视角、背景变化）进行了评估。结果表明，在理想条件下，四种策略的任务成功率可达$50$-$75\%$，深度误差是所有架构中主要的失败模式。在所有策略中，$π_0$凭借预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络取得了最强性能，表现出更高的数据效率、更强的背景变化鲁棒性以及与手术工作流程兼容的更平滑轨迹。在外科医生-机器人缝合试验中部署时，$π_0$实现了$92\%$的缝合完成率。这些发现确立了开放手术中的协作机器人辅助作为模仿学习的可行目标，并强调了深度感知与末端执行器设计是临床转化中的关键优先方向。

Authors: Xucheng Wang, Zhizhou Yang, Xiaoman Zhang, Sung Eun Kim, Romain Hardy, Pranav Rajpurkar

SARAD: LLM-Based Safety-Aware Hybrid Reinforcement Learning with Collision Prediction for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

LLM-guided DRL collision prediction Retrieval-Augmented Generation attention discriminator Highway-Env

简要说明：SARAD将LLM引导的决策与深度强化学习相结合，用检索增强生成的专家知识替代随机探索，并添加碰撞预测模块以提高自动驾驶的安全性。

TLDR: SARAD combines LLM-guided decision-making with DRL, replacing random exploration with RAG-enhanced expert knowledge and adding a collision predictor to improve safety in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Ensuring both safety and efficiency in decision-making for autonomous driving systems remains a fundamental challenge. Traditional Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) suffers from unsafe random exploration and slow convergence, while Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate inherent latency in real-time inference operations. To address these limitations, this paper proposes SARAD, a novel safety-aware hybrid framework that synergizes LLMs and DRL for autonomous driving. SARAD substitutes the random exploration of DRL with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-enhanced, LLM-guided decisions sourced from a dynamic expert knowledge repository. An attention discriminator is proposed to integrate the prior knowledge of LLMs into DRL policy optimization. A collision predictor module, fine-tuned with historical collision data, is further designed to improve vehicle safety. Extensive experiments show that SARAD achieves significant performance improvements in the Highway-Env simulator, validating the effectiveness of the proposed model in autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：确保自动驾驶系统决策过程中的安全性与高效性仍是一项根本性挑战。传统的深度强化学习（DRL）存在随机探索不安全、收敛速度慢的问题，而大语言模型（LLMs）在实时推理操作中表现出固有延迟。针对这些局限，本文提出SARAD——一种融合LLMs与DRL的新型安全感知混合框架，用于自动驾驶。SARAD利用来自动态专家知识库的、经检索增强生成（RAG）优化的LLM引导决策，替代DRL的随机探索。为将LLM的先验知识融入DRL策略优化，本文提出一种注意力判别器。此外，通过历史碰撞数据微调的碰撞预测模块被进一步设计以提升车辆安全性。广泛实验表明，SARAD在Highway-Env仿真器中取得了显著性能提升，验证了所提模型在自动驾驶中的有效性。

Authors: Kangyu Wu, Peng Cui, Guoxi Chen, Ya Zhang

Learning a Kinodynamic Trajectory Manifold for Impact-Aware Compliant Catching of Fast-Moving Objects Manipulation

reinforcement learning kinodynamic trajectory manifold impact-aware compliant catching fast-moving objects compliant control

简要说明：本文利用强化学习在仿真中学习低维动力学轨迹流形，用于快速抓取自由飞行的物体，实现在运行时直接从物体初始状态映射到参考轨迹而无需在线非线性优化，并通过柔顺控制改善冲击吸收和抓取稳定性。

TLDR: This paper uses reinforcement learning to learn a low-dimensional kinodynamic trajectory manifold for fast catching of free-flying objects, enabling run-time mapping from object state to reference trajectory without online optimization and using compliant control for impact absorption.

Abstract: Fast catching of free-flying objects is difficult because of short reaction time, impact uncertainty, and kinodynamic constraints. We use reinforcement learning in simulation to collect successful catching trajectories and learn a low-dimensional kinodynamic trajectory manifold. At run time, the estimated object initial state is mapped directly to a reference catching trajectory without online nonlinear optimization. The trajectory is tracked with compliant control near contact for improved impact absorption and capture stability.

摘要（中文）：摘要：快速抓取自由飞行物体因反应时间短、碰撞不确定性及运动动力学约束而极具挑战性。我们在仿真中通过强化学习收集成功抓取轨迹，学习低维运动动力学轨迹流形。在运行时，估计的物体初始状态直接映射为参考抓取轨迹，无需在线非线性优化。该轨迹在接近接触时采用柔顺控制跟踪，以提升冲击吸收与抓取稳定性。

Authors: Guorui Pei, Mengshi Zhang, Xi Chen, Jinsong Wu, Jiaming Qi, Peng Zhou

Magnet-Based Soft Robotic Skin Using a 3D-Printed Multi-Lattice Structure and CNN-Based Tactile Super-Resolution Manipulation

tactile sensing soft robotic skin Hall-effect sensor CNN super-resolution 3D-printed lattice

简要说明：一种利用3D打印多层晶格、霍尔效应传感器和CNN实现触觉超分辨率的磁性机器人皮肤，可用于全身机器人皮肤和人机安全交互。

TLDR: A tactile super-resolution skin using a 3D-printed multi-layer lattice, Hall-effect sensors, and a CNN to estimate contact location and force, with potential for whole-body robotic skin.

Abstract: This paper presents a magnet-based robotic skin that integrates a multilayer soft lattice with distributed Hall-effect sensor arrays and a tactile super-resolution model. External contact forces are converted to magnetic field changes by embedded permanent magnets, and the lattice spreads these changes across the sensing domain. This gives each sensor a large, overlapping receptive field and enables a large sensing area with minimal blind spots. Lattice parameters are tunable, enabling joint adjustment of mechanical compliance and transduction characteristics. An implicit modeling workflow and selective laser sintering (SLS) 3D printing support rapid fabrication of conformal, high-complexity structures. A convolutional neural network trained on experimental measurements estimates contact location and normal force in real time. Experiments validate localization accuracy and indicate scalability to larger surfaces, suggesting applicability to whole-body robotic skin and safe human-robot interaction.

摘要（中文）：本文提出一种基于磁场的机器人皮肤，该皮肤集成了多层软体晶格、分布式霍尔效应传感器阵列及触觉超分辨率模型。外部接触力通过嵌入的永磁体转化为磁场变化，而晶格将这些变化扩散至整个传感域，使每个传感器具备大范围重叠感受野，从而在实现大传感面积的同时将盲区最小化。晶格参数可调节，支持机械柔顺性与换能特性的协同调整。采用隐式建模工作流与选择性激光烧结（SLS）3D打印技术，可快速制造共形、高复杂度结构。基于实验测量数据训练的卷积神经网络能够实时估算接触位置与法向力。实验验证了定位精度，并表明该方法可扩展至更大表面积，适用于全身机器人皮肤及安全的人机交互场景。

Authors: Yunseong Bang, Joowon Park, Suan Sim, Youngjun Ryu, Sukho Park, Kyungseo Park

POINav: Benchmarking and Enhancing Final-Meters Arrival in Real-World Vision-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation POI-goal navigation 3D Gaussian Splatting closed-loop evaluation Brain-Action Framework

简要说明：POINav提出了一个真实世界视觉语言导航基准，基于3DGS重建环境，并设计了脑-动作框架实现精确POI目标到达。

TLDR: POINav introduces a real-world vision-language navigation benchmark with 3DGS-reconstructed environments and a Brain-Action framework for precise POI-goal arrival.

Abstract: Real-world navigation is fundamentally driven by Points of Interest (POIs), yet reaching a precise POI remains a critical "final-meters" challenge. Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) benchmarks of POI-goal navigation often suffer from coarse granularity or significant sim-to-real gaps due to generated scene. To bridge this gap, we present POINav-Bench, the first benchmark designed for closed-loop evaluation of real-world POI-goal navigation. It comprises 11 commercial areas reconstructed from real-world captures using 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), covering 126,398 $m^{2}$ in total and spanning 163 distinct POIs. With traversability-aware annotations and reference trajectories, POINav-Bench enables high-fidelity evaluation of navigation agents in realistic, POI-rich real-world environments. Building on this, we propose the POINav Brain-Action Framework where a Brain module performs POI-grounded reasoning to guide an Action module in predicting continuous waypoints for real-world execution. We further curate the POINav-Dataset, containing 70K real-world signage-entrance pairs. Experiments show that our framework provides a viable path toward refining real-world POI-goal navigation.

摘要（中文）：现实世界的导航本质上以兴趣点（POIs）为驱动，但精确抵达某个兴趣点仍是一项关键的“最后几米”挑战。现有的面向兴趣点目标的视觉语言导航（VLN）基准测试常因生成场景而存在颗粒度粗糙或显著的仿真到现实差距。为弥合这一差距，我们提出POINav-Bench，这是首个专为现实世界兴趣点目标导航闭环评估设计的基准测试。它包含11个商业区域，这些区域利用3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）从真实场景重建，总面积达126,398平方米，涵盖163个不同的兴趣点。凭借可通行性感知标注与参考轨迹，POINav-Bench能够在真实、富含兴趣点的现实环境中对导航智能体进行高保真度评估。在此基础上，我们提出POINav脑-动作框架，其中脑模块执行基于兴趣点的推理以指导动作模块预测用于现实执行的连续航点。我们进一步整理了POINav-Dataset，包含7万对真实世界的标识-入口对。实验表明，我们的框架为改进现实世界兴趣点目标导航提供了一条可行路径。

Authors: Ruiyan Gong, Meisheng Zhang, Yuxiang Zhao, Mingchao Sun, Yanfen Shen, Zedong Chu, Zhining Gu, Wei Guo, Xiaolong Cheng, Qiming Li, Kangning Niu, Yanqing Zhu, Xiaolong Wu, Tianlun Li, Mu Xu

Natural Functional Gradients for Smooth Trajectory Optimization Manipulation

trajectory optimization natural functional gradients Gaussian smoothing constrained manipulation collision-free motion

简要说明：该论文提出了一种使用自然函数梯度与高斯平滑的轨迹优化框架，能够在无需解析梯度的情况下，在杂乱机器人操作环境中生成无碰撞且平滑的运动。

TLDR: This paper proposes a trajectory optimization framework using natural functional gradients with Gaussian smoothing, enabling collision-free and smooth motion generation in cluttered robotic manipulation environments without requiring analytic gradients.

Abstract: Generating collision-free and smooth motions remains a central challenge in robotic manipulation, particularly in cluttered environments and narrow passages where feasible regions are highly constrained and fragmented. We propose a trajectory optimization framework that performs geometry-aware updates directly in function space using natural functional gradients. The method optimizes a Gaussian-smoothed surrogate objective that regularizes the optimization landscape through smooth trajectory perturbations while preserving trajectory-level structure. Because the updates are defined intrinsically in function space, trajectory regularity can be controlled independently of a particular time discretization. We derive a practical Monte-Carlo estimator of the natural functional gradient that requires only black-box trajectory evaluations, making the method applicable when analytic gradients are unavailable or unreliable due to collision checking and contact-rich simulation. Experiments on constrained robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that the proposed method improves trajectory feasibility and produces smoother motions than representative planning and trajectory optimization baselines in environments with narrow geometric clearances. Additional results, videos, and implementation details are available at the project page: https://kisangpark.github.io/natural-functional-gradient/

摘要（中文）：生成无碰撞且平滑的运动仍然是机器人操作中的一个核心挑战，尤其是在杂乱环境和狭窄通道中，可行区域高度受限且零散。我们提出了一种轨迹优化框架，该框架利用自然函数梯度直接在函数空间中进行几何感知更新。该方法优化了高斯平滑的替代目标函数，通过平滑的轨迹扰动正则化优化景观，同时保留了轨迹层面的结构。由于更新本质上定义在函数空间中，轨迹的规律性可以独立于特定的时间离散化进行控制。我们推导了一种实用的自然函数梯度蒙特卡罗估计器，该估计器仅需黑盒轨迹评估，使得该方法在由于碰撞检测和接触丰富的仿真而导致解析梯度不可用或不可靠时仍可应用。在受限机器人操作任务上的实验表明，与代表性的规划及轨迹优化基线方法相比，所提出的方法在几何间隙狭窄的环境中能够提高轨迹可行性并生成更平滑的运动。更多结果、视频及实现细节可访问项目页面：https://kisangpark.github.io/natural-functional-gradient/

Authors: Kisang Park, Chanwoo Kim, Kyungjae Lee, Sungjoon Choi

Simultaneous Contact Selection and Planning for Contact-Rich Manipulation with Cascaded Optimization Manipulation

contact-implicit optimization contact selection cascaded optimization manipulation planning robust control

简要说明：一种用于富含接触操作的级联优化框架，可同时选择接触位置并规划轨迹，在真实机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: A cascaded optimization framework for contact-rich manipulation that simultaneously selects contact locations and plans trajectories, validated on real robots.

Abstract: We propose an optimization-based framework for robust contact-rich manipulation. Recent contact-implicit methods enable online hybrid planning across contact modes, allowing closed-loop manipulation for a given target state and contact location sequence of the robot and object. However, most existing approaches lack the ability to autonomously reason and generate diverse contact location sequences and manipulation trajectories, i.e., active contact location selection, which limits their applicability to relatively simple tasks. Active contact location selection is challenging due to complementarity in contact dynamics and the sparse gradients, making the design of a unified framework for contact selection and planning difficult. To address these challenges, we introduce Simultaneous Contact Selection and Planning (SCSP), a cascaded optimization framework comprising Contact Selection Optimization (CSO) and Contact Planning Optimization (CPO). CSO leverages a surrogate contact model and discrete-continuous optimization to efficiently resolve the nonsmoothness and coupling in contact selection, enabling online global searching of optimal contact locations. CPO performs prior-guided contact planning by evaluating the reference contact locations produced by CSO and generating corresponding manipulation trajectories in real time for redundant manipulators. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that SCSP produces diverse manipulation behaviors and robust control under inaccurate dynamics and perceptual noise. We further validate the generalization of the framework on challenging manipulation tasks. Project website: \href{https://sites.google.com/view/scsp-robot}{https://sites.google.com/view/scsp-robot}.

摘要（中文）：摘要：我们提出了一种基于优化的鲁棒接触式操作框架。现有接触隐式方法能够实现跨接触模式的在线混合规划，从而针对给定的目标状态及机器人与物体的接触位置序列执行闭环操作。然而，大多数现有方法缺乏自主推理并生成多样化接触位置序列与操作轨迹的能力（即主动接触位置选择），这限制了其在相对简单任务上的适用性。由于接触动力学中的互补性条件以及稀疏梯度，主动接触位置选择极具挑战性，这使得设计统一的接触选择与规划框架变得困难。为解决上述挑战，我们提出了同时接触选择与规划（SCSP）——一个级联优化框架，包含接触选择优化（CSO）与接触规划优化（CPO）两个模块。CSO利用替代接触模型与离散-连续优化，高效解决接触选择中的非光滑性与耦合问题，实现最优接触位置的在线全局搜索。CPO通过评估CSO生成的参考接触位置，为冗余机械臂实时生成对应的操作轨迹，从而执行先验引导的接触规划。大量仿真与真实世界实验表明，SCSP在动力学不准确及感知噪声环境下能生成多样化操作行为并实现鲁棒控制。我们进一步在具有挑战性的操作任务中验证了该框架的泛化能力。 项目网站：\href{https://sites.google.com/view/scsp-robot}{https://sites.google.com/view/scsp-robot}

Authors: Zhe Zhang, Xingrong Diao, Haoxiang Liang, Han Yang, Bi-Ke Zhu, Dandan Zhang, Jiankun Wang

VLM-Based Advanced Rider Assistance System for Motorcycle Safety AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language Models motorcycle safety risk-aware planning sampling-based planner CARLA simulator

简要说明：本文提出一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的摩托车高级骑手辅助系统（ARAS），通过语义危险推理和采样规划生成风险地图和安全控制动作，并在CARLA仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a VLM-based Advanced Rider Assistance System (ARAS) for motorcycle safety, integrating semantic hazard reasoning and sampling-based planning to produce risk maps and safe control actions, evaluated in CARLA simulations.

Abstract: Motorcycles face disproportionately high crash risks compared to cars due to limited protection and heightened sensitivity to surface hazards, yet Advanced Rider Assistance Systems (ARAS) remain underdeveloped relative to Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). We propose a novel ARAS that enhances motorcycle safety through semantic perception and risk-aware planning. Our approach leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for contextual hazard reasoning and integrates them with segmentation-based detection to construct dense risk maps. These maps encode both semantic characteristics (e.g., pothole severity, puddle slipperiness) and physical attributes (e.g., size, depth), which produce per-pixel hazard costs that capture motorcycle-specific risks. These maps are used by a sampling-based planner tailored to motorcycle dynamics to recommend throttle and steering actions that minimize hazard exposure while advancing toward the destination. We evaluate our system in different scenarios in the CARLA simulator. Compared to the baseline method, our method achieves higher success rates and lower hazard exposure, while qualitative results demonstrate interpretable risk maps and safe trajectory recommendations.

摘要（中文）：摩托车相较于汽车面临不成比例的高碰撞风险，原因在于其防护有限且对路面隐患高度敏感，然而先进的骑手辅助系统（ARAS）相比高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）仍发展不足。我们提出了一种新型ARAS，通过语义感知和风险感知规划增强摩托车安全性。该方法利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行上下文危险推理，并与基于分割的检测相结合，构建稠密风险地图。这些风险地图同时编码语义特征（如坑洼严重程度、水坑湿滑度）和物理属性（如尺寸、深度），从而生成逐像素危险代价，精准捕捉摩托车特有的风险。代价地图由专为摩托车动力学设计的基于采样的规划器使用，用以推荐节气门和转向操作，在向目的地行进的同时最小化危险暴露。我们在CARLA模拟器的不同场景中评估了该系统。与基线方法相比，本方法实现了更高的成功率和更低的危险暴露，定性结果展示了可解释的风险地图和安全的轨迹推荐。
